verdict.rationale: Ramp's documented agent tooling covers the core loop. The AI Agents guide says agents can search transactions and load accounting categories, tracking categories and departments, and lists edits and approvals among their actions. The CLI's transactions resource includes list/get/edit/missing/flag-missing/memo-suggestions/approve. The live MCP server exposes transactions:read, transactions:write and accounting:write scopes, and the Transactions API serves the same data server-to-server. Missing for 10: an explicit filter for uncoded transactions (missing GL or accounting fields), documented field-level write of accounting coding via the API, a review or staging state for agent-proposed coding, agent-raised policy-violation flags (flag-missing covers missing items only), and independent hands-on corroboration of the write path.
